metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds Richard's twenty-first, Daniel read standing, a note after Paul's, Gilbert's call, and a minute at the window.

yesterday: Your brother Richard turned twenty-one in Stratford. Neither you nor Gilbert sent anything home.
You read the first book of Daniel's Civil Wars standing at Waterson's stall in Paul's Churchyard. Two shillings was too dear.
Gilbert read out a shop-ticket of your father's three Stratford debts: 41s to the other baker, 44s 6d to the shoemaker, and 14s 6d to the whittawer, which he called near £5.
The 14s 6d whittawer's bill on Gilbert's ticket is the same debt Anne mentioned in Sunday's postscript.
